text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It's no use... No matter how many times I 
try, like this...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Expressing my beauty through all five 
senses, behold: the "Overlord Cuisine 
~Full Course~"...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Appearance! Aroma! Texture! The sweet 
harmony the ingredients make with every 
bite!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Everything should be perfect... but no 
matter how many times I make it, the most 
vital part, the flavor... is utterly 
unworthy of my beauty...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Am I doomed to just pointlessly 
taste-test the full-course meal again 
today?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
N-No! It's just, um... along with that 
lovely smell, I heard the words "taste 
test"...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh my...! Could it be that you'd like a 
taste test?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
No, but granting an incomplete beauty... 
As the "Overlord," I cannot allow such a 
thing—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I want to help! For the sake 
of delici—... I mean, flawless beauty!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Spe! I understand...! I shall entrust this 
great duty to you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, without any chances to taste-test, 
TM Opera O slimmed back down.
